div.div:
Reading the gateway arrow
The gateway reaches every service on HTTP :8080 through its route set on gateway.duynh.me: /public and /private for the storefront (customer realm JWT), /protected for the back-office on product, inventory, order, payment, shipping and user (staff realm JWT). Inventory exposes only /protected over HTTP. Every service also verifies tokens itself against Keycloak's JWKS (pkg/authmw), which is not drawn.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1018px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1080px; margin-left: 12px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#475569, #9ba7b8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Elsewhere
checkout starts AbandonedCheckoutWorkflow and the order API starts OrderFulfillmentWorkflow and CancellationWorkflow on Temporal; the order worker's calls above are that workflow's activities (workflows/temporal-keda). mockpay posts its webhook to payment in-cluster; the gateway's webhook route is used by local-stack only. Databases and the Valkey cache are databases/topology.
